# Authentication API

8 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `POST /api/v1/auth/change-password`

Change password

Change the password for the current user

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `current_password` | string | yes | - |
| `new_password` | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Password changed successfully, no content | - |
| `400` | Invalid request | - |
| `401` | Not authenticated or invalid current password | - |

### `POST /api/v1/auth/login`

Login

Authenticate with username and password

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `password` | string | yes | - |
| `username` | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Login successful, returns user object | `application/json`: [User](schemas.md#user) |
| `401` | Invalid credentials | - |

### `POST /api/v1/auth/logout`

Logout

Logout the current user (same-origin only). Sessions created by an OIDC provider whose IdP advertises an end_session_endpoint get 200 with the RP-initiated logout URL to navigate to.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Logged out locally; continue at the IdP | `application/json`: [EndSessionResponse](schemas.md#endsessionresponse) |
| `204` | Logout successful, no content | - |
| `403` | Cross-site request rejected | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/auth/me`

Get current user

Returns information about the currently authenticated user

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Current user information | `application/json`: [UserExtended](schemas.md#userextended) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | - |

### `GET /api/v1/auth/sso/providers`

List SSO providers

List available SSO providers (public)

**Authentication:** none (public endpoint).

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of SSO providers | `application/json`: array of object |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `[].display_name` | string | no | - |
| `[].kind` | string | no | One of: `oidc`, `saml`. |
| `[].slug` | string | no | - |

### `GET /api/v1/auth/tokens`

List own API tokens

List API tokens for the current user

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List of tokens | `application/json`: object |

Fields of the `200` response (`application/json`):

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | array of [Token](schemas.md#token) | no | - |

### `POST /api/v1/auth/tokens`

Create own API token

Create a new API token for the current user

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expires_at` | string (date-time) | no | - |
| `kind` | string | yes | One of: `access`, `deploy`. |
| `name` | string | yes | - |
| `scopes` | array of string | no | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `201` | Token created | `application/json`: [TokenCreateResponse](schemas.md#tokencreateresponse) |

### `DELETE /api/v1/auth/tokens/{id}`

Revoke own API token

Revoke an API token for the current user

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Token revoked | - |
| `404` | Token not found | - |
